source: CDC NHANES August 2021-August 2023, DEMO_L + BMX_L; adults 20+, pregnant women excluded
method: WTMEC2YR; lb = kg x 2.2046 (NCHS); percentiles from the weighted CDF over distinct values, linear interpolation; Taylor linearization, 15 strata x 2 PSUs, t(15) = 2.1314
checks: reproduces Series 3 No. 50 Table 4 (16 means, 144 percentiles) and the adult rows of Table 8 (height mean and 9 percentiles), Table 10 (BMI mean and median) and Table 12 (waist mean and 9 percentiles, cm) exactly at 0.1 (204 values); heights keep pregnant women, as Table 8 does
